title: Rentals Settlement Note: Rental Set-Aside on Driver Instant Cashouts
content:
When a driver cashes out as much as possible under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, a rental set-aside is kept from the largest instant cashout. The rental set-aside follows the driver's rental under **Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals)**, read from the rental's status, its balance due and its vehicle class:

- an active rental with a balance due sets aside that balance due for the weekly rental deduction;
- an active rental with nothing due sets aside the class's weekly rate for the next weekly charge;
- a rental that is not active, or no rental, sets aside nothing.

The rental set-aside is taken off the balance at the same point as the cashout fee: after the balance has been settled and risk-treated, and before the result is compared with what remains of the day's cashout limit.

## Status table

| Wayfare Rentals rental | Rental set-aside |
|---|---|
| Active, with a balance due | The balance due |
| Active, nothing due | The weekly rate of the rental's vehicle class |
| Returned, return due, closed, or any other status that is not active | Nothing |
| No rental | Nothing |

## Hypothetical rentals

| Rental | Balance due | Class weekly rate | Set-aside |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | 145.00 | 289.00 | 145.00 |
| Active | 0.00 | 289.00 | 289.00 |
| Returned | 145.00 | 289.00 | 0.00 |
| None | | | 0.00 |
